_comment: Shared wire fixture for the per-viewer userTrustlines endpoint (GET /api/v1/networks/{net}/users/{addr}/trustlines). Pinned from the LIVE prod ledger (api.foaf.io, 2026-08-24) so the TS read-side hooks and the Ruby gem cannot re-drift from each other. TRUTH: robin owes alex $166.80. These rows are ALREADY viewer-oriented (the network API has applied the viewer's perspective): `balance` is the viewer's balance (negative = the viewer owes, positive = the counterparty owes the viewer), `given` is credit the viewer extended TO the counterparty, `received` is credit the counterparty extended TO the viewer. This is the OPPOSITE endpoint from the raw creditor-oriented /trustlines row in viewer-balance.json (which needs viewer_balance = -balance). NO negation is applied to these rows.
